remarks: Downtown SoNo! 1 bedroom unit with great sunlight, views and plenty of activities within walking distance. Living area has 9' vaulted ceilings-great space, ample closets throughout, open concept galley kitchen to living area with a breakfast bar, renovated oversized bathroom with new tiles and fixtures, new central A/C, new hot water heater, utilities are all electric, stack washer and dryer in unit. Security video buzzed in at front door of building. Just steps away from Metro North Train, Vets Park, SoNo Mall, Parks, Beach, Dining, Entertainment, Shopping, IMax, and more... Landlord will pay the MOVE IN/MOVE OUT FEE. PARKING INCLUDED FOR 1 CAR at the lower level of the Haviland St parking lot. Unit is on 3rd floor. Applicants must have excellent credit, provide proof of ability to pay, references, background check, no smoking and no pets.
